      "type": "stanza_note",
      "lines": [
        {"n": 1, "text": "ed ; from that खली like मण्डली, कपाली &c. अर्कमूलस्य हेतोः. For the case", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 2, "text": "here see Siddh. Kaum I., 295. It is an emetic and has other", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 3, "text": "bad effects. कर्पूर = घनसार Râmarshi. I am told that it is a thing re-", "end": "hyphen"},
        {"n": 4, "text": "sembling arrowroot. खण्डः= collection. Comp. Kâdambarî p. 44 and", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 5, "text": "elsewhere. कर्मभूमि. This world is often so-called. The idea is some-", "end": "hyphen"},
        {"n": 6, "text": "what similar to that of Bishop Butler who calls this a world for", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 7, "text": "man's probation. See Râmâyaṇa (Bomb. Ed.) Ayodhyâkâṇḍa", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 8, "text": "CIX., 28 (p. 205) कर्मभूमिमिमां प्राप्य कर्तव्यं कर्म यच्छुभम्. See also Muir V.,", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 9, "text": "325 (Ed. 1870) कर्मभूमिरियं ब्रह्मन्फलभूमिरसौ मता which fixes the mean-", "end": "hyphen"},
        {"n": 10, "text": "", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 11, "text": "ing precisely. Râmarshi renders it by भरतखण्डे जन्म. तपस् = स्वधर्मे", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 12, "text": "", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 13, "text": "निष्ठा, सत्क्रिया (commentary) धर्म Râmarshi. S'ankara in his comment-", "end": "hyphen"},
        {"n": 14, "text": "ary on the Pras'na Upanishad renders it by इन्द्रियसंयम. The idea", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 15, "text": "expressed in the several analogies in the first three lines is that", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 16, "text": "of good things misapplied, which is exactly the idea of the", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 17, "text": "fourth line also. The opportunities given by birth in this", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 18, "text": "world are lost when तपस् is not practised.—Sragdharâ.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "uncertain": false,
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "id": "r4",
      "type": "stanza_note",
      "lines": [
        {"n": 1, "text": "St. CI.—A man may do the most difficult and dangerous things", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 2, "text": "in order to do what is fated not to happen or to avoid what", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 3, "text": "is fated to happen. But he will fail.—S'ârdûlavikrîḍita.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "uncertain": false,
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "id": "r5",
      "type": "stanza_note",
      "lines": [
        {"n": 1, "text": "St. CII.—सन्निधिरत्नपूर्णा = full of excellent treasures and jewels, or", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 2, "text": "full of jewels in excellent collections. Râmarshi says संनिधौ समीपे", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 3, "text": "रत्नैरुत्कृष्टवस्तुभिः गवाश्वान्नवस्त्रादिभिर्मणिभिर्वा पूर्णा, of course he reads संनि°", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 4, "text": "for सन्नि°. But the construction is not a very good one.—Va-", "end": "hyphen"},
        {"n": 5, "text": "santatilakâ.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "uncertain": false,
      "note": null
    },
    {
      "id": "r6",
      "type": "stanza_note",
      "lines": [
        {"n": 1, "text": "St. CIII.—समयच्युतिः letting slip an opportunity. यस्मिन्समये यदवश्यं", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 2, "text": "कर्तव्यं तन्नकृतं समयो गतः (commentary). अनुव्रता = पतिव्रता (commentary).", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 3, "text": "Comp. Râmâyaṇa (Gorresio) XIX., 24. आज्ञाफलम् = the fruit of", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 4, "text": "which is the capacity to command, to enforce obedience. Comp.", "end": "space"},
        {"n": 5, "text": "St. 48 and note. The commentary says somewhat obscurely.—यस्या-", "end": "hyphen"},
        {"n": 6, "text": "ज्ञया सर्वं शुभाशुभं भवति सामर्थ्यं वर्तते तदेव राज्यम् । उक्तं च । पञ्चा (? श्व—X.)", "end": "join"},
        {"n": 7, "text": "नामपि यो भर्ता सोपि राजा प्रकीर्तितः.—S'ârdûlavikrîḍita.", "end": "space"}
      ],
      "uncertain": false,
      "note": null
    },
